steps.title: Onboard Your Title
steps.description: Upload video, metadata, artwork, and documents. Define your territory-by-territory avails across AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, Pay TV, and Free TV — all in one workflow.

steps.title: Buyers Discover You
steps.description: Platforms and distributors search by genre, territory, festival pedigree, cast, director, and more. Your title surfaces to the right buyers — no cold calls required.

steps.title: Deals Get Done
steps.description: Rights holders and buyers connect directly on the platform. No sales agents. No market badges. No email chains. Deals start in minutes, not months.

benefits.title: Direct Access, Global Reach
benefits.description: Rights holders reach buyers in 50+ countries without a sales agent or market badge. Buyers reach verified rights holders without a conference pass.

benefits.title: Structured Discovery
benefits.description: Buyers filter by genre, territory, festival pedigree, cast, director, and release window. Structured data, not a static PDF or an email chain.

benefits.title: Avails Engine
benefits.description: Multi-territory licensing availability declared upfront. Buyers know what's available before the first conversation — by window, by territory.

benefits.title: Verified Identities
benefits.description: Every rights holder and buyer is identity-verified. Screeners reach verified acquisition professionals, not anonymous inboxes.

benefits.title: Always On
benefits.description: The marketplace never sleeps. Unlike Cannes or AFM, deals can start at 2am on a Tuesday — from anywhere in the world.
